serviceRecords.description: Replaced Honeywell 20x25x4 MERV 11 filter in attic plenum. Vacuumed return grill.
Annual spring check. Chemically washed outdoor condenser coil, checked amp draw on compressor and fan motor, verified R-410A charge and subcooling at 10.5F. Condensate safety float switch tested.
Slow drip observed behind lower ice maker valve. Tech replaced dual water inlet solenoid valve under warranty. Zero out-of-pocket cost.
Replaced genuine GE RPWFE filter and reset water filter button on control panel. Flushed 2 gallons of water through dispenser.
Error code E24 triggered (drain pump blocked). Discovered tiny piece of broken wine glass wedged in drain impeller under white plastic cover. Cleared debris and replaced pump cover gasket.

Spring service. Drained old oil, added 18.5 oz Mobil 1 10W-30 Full Synthetic. Cleaned foam pre-filter in warm soapy water and re-oiled. Checked NGK spark plug gap at 0.029". Ran with space heater load test for 20 mins.

projects.title: Clean Gutters & Flush Downspouts
projects.description: Clear leaves, pine needles, and roofing granules from all gutters and flush downspouts to prevent foundation overflow.

checklist.text: Set up ladder standoff stabilizer safely on roof edge
Scoop leaf debris into bucket and bag for yard compost
Run garden hose through downspouts to verify clean drainage
Inspect gutter slope and re-secure loose fascia brackets

projects.materialsNeeded: Gloves, gutter scoop, bucket, garden hose, ladder standoff
projects.notes: Clean both front porch and two-story rear roofline. Re-check before first heavy freeze.

projects.title: Exterior Trim, Fascia & Front Door Painting
projects.description: Scrape, prime, and apply two coats of exterior satin acrylic paint to front door, garage door trim, and window sills.

checklist.text: Pressure wash trim and allow 48 hours dry time
Scrape peeling spots and spot prime with Zinsser 1-2-3
Caulk gaps around window trim with exterior polyurethane
Apply 2 coats Benjamin Moore Aura Exterior Satin (Iron Mountain)

projects.materialsNeeded: 2 gal BM Aura Exterior Satin (Color: Iron Mountain 2134-30), 2.5" angled sash brushes, drop cloths
projects.notes: Paint only on dry days above 50°F and below 85% humidity.

projects.title: Spring Landscaping, Lawn Aeration & Fresh Mulch
projects.description: Core aerate lawn, apply pre-emergent fertilizer, spade edge all perennial beds, and spread 4 yards of dark brown mulch.

checklist.text: Rent core aerator from local equipment yard
Aerate front, back, and side lawns
Trench crisp 3" edge along all perennial beds and tree rings
Order & spread 4 yards dark brown double-shredded mulch

projects.materialsNeeded: 4 cu yd dark brown mulch, Scotts Halts pre-emergent, spade shovel, wheelbarrow
projects.notes: Call 811 utility line locator before aerating near buried internet cables.

projects.title: Pressure Wash Driveway, Walkways & Patio
projects.description: Surface clean concrete driveway, sidewalk, and rear patio using 15" surface cleaner attachment.

checklist.text: Pre-treat driveway oil stains with concrete degreaser
Connect 15" rotating surface cleaner to pressure washer wand
Rinse loose sediment toward street gutter with 40° fan tip

projects.materialsNeeded: 15" surface cleaner, degreaser, ear protection, goggles
